description: Read the verification graph of one list: every document verified against it (`statements`, the latest finished verification of each), their claims with the verdict as reviewers see it now (a re-check counts, a governed record conflict takes the governing record's verdict), the review status and qualifiers, the list's facts (`held` when kept out of scoring, `tier`: `document`, `testimony` or `unsourced`; a fact off the list that a claim still cites has `listed` false), and the documents the facts come from (`sources`). `citations` links a claim to each fact it rests on: `cites` with the relation its grade gives (`supports`, `conflicts`, `record`), or `record-conflict` for each of the two records a withheld verdict sits between. `provenance` links a fact to a source document at its locator. Paginated by documents with a cursor; a document with more claims than `limit` continues on the next page. Every page carries the list's facts, at most 1000 of them: `factOverflow` is true when the list holds more, so check it before treating the facts as complete.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
